reviews.comment: Dr. Lacy is a great professor and teaches composite materials very well. 471 is a very difficult class but he provides so many opportunities to learn well. I have never had a professor that sits on the phone with me for 2 hours helping me with a homework assignment on the weekend. He truly is a great teacher and wants you to learn.

Tough course, course material, and workload are heavy. But Dr. Lacy is a nice guy, he enjoys teaching and is willing to answer questions patiently, which makes the course not that difficult. Do not take it if you want an easy A, but as you work hard you will be good at the end.

Dr Lacy is very passionate about composites but is very difficult to follow during his lectures since he goes into such depth about the subject, it almost seems like he thinks we know all this information already. The class is coding heavy but the homeworks are done in pairs so make sure you find someone that is good at coding.

Dr. Lacy's tone may not be the most engaging, but he certainly knows his material and enjoys talking to you about the concepts. Does tend to go off on rabbit trails, but he also brought in composite samples (some of which helped me on the tests). Class required coding in Python/Matlab to solve many problems, so get started on the code early!
Tough class. Involves a semester long code with many different parts. Reads off a set of 4-5 pdf slides all semester. Mix of graduate students and undergraduate student.

His lectures are very dry and difficult to focus in. Outside class he answers any question you have but wow he drags out questions. He may talk on one problem for 45 minutes. Some concepts are not that bad but he makes it out to seem like a mountain. He does care and he will make time for students always. Regardless of prof this class is lot of HW!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor has a hard time reaching to people what he is teaching about. He seems very knowledgeable on the subject, however at the same time he makes problems more complicated than they really are, especially on exams. He is an extremely tough grader as well . If you can, try to take a different prof.

Dr. Lacy was a fantastic professor. The class itself had a lot of projects and quizzes, but this is true for all MEEN 225 classes. He always made time to see students outside of class and prepared everyone extremely well for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Although the class is a lot of work with online homework, online tests (have to show your work), analysis projects, a midterm, and a final, Dr. Lacy makes it easy to succeed. His voice can be monotone at times. His policy with due dates was "as long as he hasn't finish grading all of them then it's not late," which I abused way too often.
